did: I gave every video one schema: an intro and an outro carrying the brand, and a music bed under the silences, on by default for every series and left out only where a series says why, never by a single video. The template videos already had all three; the cards essays now get them from version 6 of their series, with the brand's own open and close in the series' theme. Home now writes our synthesised bed itself wherever a video is rendered, so nothing has to be laid on home by hand. I also made the cards check refuse a new essay whose chapter talks about our app (on the phone, in the web app, in Studio) without showing a screen of it, so the next Rust Rounds essay shows the phone instead of describing it.

calls.title: Every video's intro, outro and bed are one policy per series, on by default (C1480)
options: One family per series as policy in code, checked on the newest versions and at publish
Apply the defaults at render time to every version, old videos included
A field on each video's cut list
calls.why: Versions are never edited once a video pins them, and you ruled out a per-video opt-out; the brand's existing open and close is the intro and outro, so nothing new is designed.
calls.undo: Name a series and the parts it leaves out in bookends.ts, or pin a new series version whose intro or outro names another composition.

left: The Grafana dashboards screen source and its part of the show-what-we-own check wait on #3472, the mock-telemetry Grafana.
The show-what-we-own check reads phrases, not meaning: a line that describes our app in other words still passes, and one that uses a phrase for something else has to be reworded.
Home draws the new cheat-sheet version only once its render image is rebuilt from main, so the remade essays publish after that release.
The Build Journal short, a test fixture series and the landing's muted promos are opted out with their reasons.
